create.name: Marion Gilbert
create.bio:
Marion Gilbert, an American teacher of embodied awareness, founded the Somatic Enneagram. She has been a registered physical therapist since 1978, and in Grass Valley, California, she runs her own practice and a movement studio; she also trained in craniosacral therapy and SomatoEmotional Release. Her work with the Enneagram began in 2003. Four years later she joined the core faculty of the Narrative Enneagram tradition, and she is still adjunct faculty of The Narrative Enneagram. She is also on the advisory board of the Enneagram Prison Project.

In her hands the Enneagram becomes a map of the body as much as of thought and feeling. Students learn to notice how their type appears in physical habits and reactions, through three practices: grounded presence, cultivating an inner observer and placing attention deliberately. The aim is to bring body, heart and mind into balance, a state she calls three-centred awareness. She teaches the Somatic Enneagram through online training modules, a professional certification path and residential retreats in the United States, Europe and Egypt. A free weekly online meditation is part of her offering, she appears on The Somatic Enneagram Podcast, and a new programme with The Shift Network is in preparation.

courses.title: Advanced Inward Turn Retreat (France)
courses.description: A six-day residential retreat in France, led with Jérémy Brossard and taught in English with French translation, for students who have completed Somatic Enneagram Modules 1 to 3. It deepens three-centred practice in a former monastery surrounded by walking paths. Accommodation is paid separately.

courses.title: Harmony Triads Retreat: The Way of Presence (Dallas)
courses.description: A three-day retreat in Dallas, Texas, with Aaron Manes, on the Enneagram's Harmony Triads and living from three-centred awareness. It is designed for people who already know their type and want to practise it through the body. Lodging is arranged by participants.
courses.price: $525 USD early bird; $650 USD from 16 Dec 2026

courses.title: Somatic Enneagram Module 1 Online
courses.description: The foundational online training of the Somatic Enneagram, run over three days with Spanish translation available. Students move beyond knowing their type to noticing how it shows up in the body, and learn the basics of embodied presence.
courses.price: $595 USD early bird; $696 USD from 8 Feb 2027

courses.title: Somatic Enneagram Module 2 Online
courses.description: The second online module, over three days, explores what happens in the body when our defences switch on, including fight, flight and freeze patterns. It continues the path towards the Somatic Enneagram certification.
courses.price: $595 USD early bird; $695 USD from 19 Apr 2027

courses.title: Somatic Enneagram Module 3 Online
courses.description: The third online module looks beneath everyday reactions at the deeper survival strategies of each Enneagram type, through somatic inquiry and group practice. It completes the foundation needed for the advanced retreats and certification.
courses.price: $595 USD early bird; $696 USD from 31 May 2027

free_resources.title: Monday Meditations
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation with Marion every Monday at 8am Pacific time on Zoom, open to beginners and experienced meditators. Sessions use breath and body awareness to settle into presence at the start of the week.

flags: Her social and YouTube accounts are the Somatic Enneagram brand accounts rather than personal ones; they are clearly her organisation's.

The YouTube videos are episodes of The Somatic Enneagram Podcast, which is co-hosted by Aaron Manes and Caryn Berley; Marion appears in each, but she may not be the only main speaker in every episode.
No book found; the Enneagram has no subject of its own, so mindfulness, meditation and spiritual-awakening are used.
